about: SCION 41 trace, measured from the render: x_screen/y_screen = centroid of the drawn dog layer (px), x_world_measured = that centroid unprojected to the dog plane Z=0 with the frame camera (m), facing = +1 head drawn toward the door (screen-left of the rump), -1 away, 0 end-on; head_facing = where the drawn muzzle points (+1 toward the door, -1 away, 0 at the camera); posture from the rig heights; state is the score state the rig executed.
